description: False-colour infrared satellite imagery depicting a diverse riverine landscape. The main river channel and associated smaller water bodies, including winding tributaries and oxbow lakes, are prominently displayed in dark blue. Extensive areas of dense vegetation, likely broadleaved forests and natural/semi-natural vegetation, appear in various shades of deep red and magenta, characteristic of strong near-infrared reflection. Agricultural fields are visible as distinct rectangular patches, displaying both deep red and lighter green/cyan hues, indicating different crop types or vegetation conditions. A small settlement with lighter green/cyan and grey features is discernible in the upper right quadrant, alongside some thin white linear features possibly representing roads or infrastructure.
